rationale: This mutation eliminates the $9,083 cash deficit by implementing all five supervisor directives: raising the land ceiling to 20-22 contiguous plots synchronized across three waves and frozen at Day 13, restricting Town Shop seed procurement strictly to Day 1-4 Carrots so 100% of Day 5+ acreage compounds hyper-fertilized Strawberries, and decoupling daytime reinvestment (1.0x payroll reserve during hours 04:00-17:00) with a two-tier liquidation floor (>=0.84x normal, >=0.78x midday) to maintain continuous capital velocity. Furthermore, it restores the farm execution dispatch order to strictly enforce in-situ harvest-and-water at Priority 1 and pre-seed hyper-fertilization at Priority 2, eliminating unfertilized plantings and dry-interval regrowth freezes.
